dataflows

object

Data Datadog collects from Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics, keyed by dataflow id.

temporal-cloud-openmetrics-metrics

object

Temporal Cloud operational metrics for your namespaces, workflows and task queues, such as workflow and activity rates, task polling, and service request latency, collected from Temporal Cloud's OpenMetrics endpoint. This is the integration's only collection: it is always on and cannot be turned off, which is why it appears in responses only.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Always true, because this collection cannot be turned off.

status

object

Read-only collection status of a dataflow.

health

enum

Collection health of a single dataflow. Allowed enum values: DATAFLOW_HEALTH_OK,DATAFLOW_HEALTH_BROKEN,DATAFLOW_HEALTH_UNKNOWN

message

string

Human-readable detail, populated when the dataflow is not healthy.

updated_at

date-time

Time the status was last computed.

name [required]

string

Human-readable name of the Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics integration account.

settings [required]

object

Settings configured on the Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics integration account.

include_opt_in_labels

boolean

When enabled, Datadog collects Temporal Cloud's opt-in labels (activity type, worker deployment name, and worker build ID) for more granularity on your existing metrics. Enabling them may increase metric collection latency.

namespaces_to_include

string

Comma-separated list of Temporal Cloud namespaces to collect metrics for. An entry can use * as a wildcard; for example, prod-* matches every namespace starting with prod-. Empty or absent when metrics are collected for all namespaces.

id [required]

string

Server-generated unique identifier of the Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics integration account.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account

data [required]

object

Data envelope for creating a Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to create a Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics integration account.

authentication [required]

 <oneOf>

Authentication for creating the Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics integration account. Exactly one method is set.

<auth_type=bearer_token>

object

Bearer token authentication. Use the API key of a Temporal Cloud service account with the Metrics Read-Only account-level role.

auth_type [required]

enum

The authentication method type. Allowed enum values: bearer_token

default: bearer_token

token [required]

string

Secret token used to authenticate with Temporal Cloud.

name [required]

string

Human-readable name of the Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics integration account.

settings [required]

object

Settings for creating the Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics integration account.

include_opt_in_labels

boolean

When enabled, Datadog collects Temporal Cloud's opt-in labels (activity type, worker deployment name, and worker build ID) for more granularity on your existing metrics. Enabling them may increase metric collection latency. Defaults to false.

namespaces_to_include

string

Comma-separated list of Temporal Cloud namespaces to collect metrics for. An entry can use * as a wildcard; for example, prod-* matches every namespace starting with prod-. Entries may contain only lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, periods and *; any other value is rejected with a 422 response. Omit it or leave it empty to collect metrics for all namespaces.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account

data [required]

object

Data envelope for updating a Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to update a Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics integration account. Every field is optional; only the fields provided are changed.

authentication

 <oneOf>

Authentication for updating the Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics integration account. Exactly one method is set.

<auth_type=bearer_token>

object

Bearer token authentication. Use the API key of a Temporal Cloud service account with the Metrics Read-Only account-level role. Only the fields provided are changed; omit token to keep the stored one.

auth_type [required]

enum

The authentication method type. Allowed enum values: bearer_token

default: bearer_token

token

string

Secret token used to authenticate with Temporal Cloud.

name

string

Human-readable name of the Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics integration account.

settings

object

Settings for updating the Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics integration account. Only the fields provided are changed.

include_opt_in_labels

boolean

When enabled, Datadog collects Temporal Cloud's opt-in labels (activity type, worker deployment name, and worker build ID) for more granularity on your existing metrics. Enabling them may increase metric collection latency.

namespaces_to_include

string

Comma-separated list of Temporal Cloud namespaces to collect metrics for. An entry can use * as a wildcard; for example, prod-* matches every namespace starting with prod-. Entries may contain only lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, periods and *; any other value is rejected with a 422 response. Omit it or leave it empty to collect metrics for all namespaces.

id [required]

string

Unique identifier of the Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics integration account to update.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account
